metadata.case_name: YEUNG TUNG SANG v. LAM JACQUELINE

plaintiff.occupation_after: sweeping and polishing floor (Cheung Kee Cleaning company)

injuries.description: right epidural haematoma, right subdural and right subarachnoid haematoma and swelling of the brain
source: He had a right epidural haematoma, right subdural and right subarachnoid haematoma and swelling of the brain.

injuries.description: depressed right skull and surgical scar
source: he has a surgical scar and depressed skull and is self-conscious of that;
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of vault of skull, unspecified

manifestations.description: lost consciousness and was in coma for 4 days
disoriented in speech and could not recognise his wife after recovery of consciousness
mild degree of confusion, with weakness in constructional ability, mental calculation and language repetition
mild degree of weakness in his lower limbs and slightly impaired walking balance
easily agitated and frequent bad mood; mildly depressed
numbness and weakness in right arm
surgical scar and depressed skull and self-consciousness
psychological fear of height (cannot climb to 1/F; can only climb about 6 feet)
increased risk of developing post-traumatic epilepsy (30 year cumulative risk 16.7% referenced by plaintiff's expert)

treatments_received: emergency operation to remove blood clots
second operation to remove the left subdural haematoma
treatments_future: neurological follow-up for 5 years to monitor post-traumatic epilepsy

losses.description: mild cognitive impairment, headaches, dizziness, numbness and weakness in right arm and other residual neurological impairments
depressed right skull and surgical scar causing self-consciousness
psychological fear of height resulting in inability to climb to 1/F (restricted to about 6 feet)
poor recent memory and mild cognitive dysfunction affecting mental calculation and language repetition

comparable_cases.case_name: Ip Shuk Hing v Yuen Yuk Wai & anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: physical injury to her right knee involving a hairline fracture of the small bone called Gerdys tubercle and also received a blow to her head which resulted in a haematoma and loss of consciousness; mild degree of permanent disability in her right leg, overall mild degree of Post Concussion Syndrome and Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, mild to moderate cognitive deficit, mild level of symptoms of headache, instability and dizziness, insomnia and anxiety
